axis_orientation: both axes flipped so HIGHER IS BETTER: depth_score = -response (more negative response = deeper regression); durability_score = -post_nadir_growth_rate (smaller growth = slower regrowth)
design: within-tumour paired differences between agents of different families in the same tumour model; bootstrap clustered on tumour model; permutation null shuffling family labels across agents
excluded: untreated arms; combination arms; agents with no family label
exploratory: all families outside the primary contrast; agent-level residuals; any comparison against the untreated regrowth floor
label_provenance: families assigned from the published 'Treatment target' string shipped with the dataset, not from independent compound knowledge
primary_hypothesis: Cytostatic families (MAPK, PI3K-mTOR, cell cycle) show SHALLOWER depth and SLOWER post-nadir regrowth than cytotoxic and apoptotic families, tested on within-tumour agent pairs.
